parsed.explanation: Combined operative regime: no criminalisation of trans identity, and a 2009 anti-discrimination law covering transgender status and a 2012 hate-crime provision exist on paper. But enforcement is weak. Police are alleged to have assaulted and harassed LGBT people in a 2024 raid, with no reported sanction. An LGBT centre suffered 20+ attacks since 2018, none properly sanctioned. Government reports cite violence against LGBTI people, and politicians' hate speech is documented. Custodial search practice by birth sex is implied by a recommendation to allow trans women to choose a female officer. Entry documents, minors and visitor-facing facility rules are not documented. Remedies are weak, so the impunity record dominates.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Anti-torture body recommends transgender women at intake be allowed to choose a female officer for searches, implying birth-sex or combined searches at the main custodial institution in the capital.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Recommendation exists but no documented implementation.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Applies only if a visitor is detained; links to police raid allegations with no sanction.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Custodial search practice documented for trans detainees; no documented facility-access restriction for visitors.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Anti-discrimination law covers transgender status in all areas.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Law prohibits discrimination, but the custody recommendation shows practice lagging law.

care_services.exposure: Surgery partly covered; hormone therapy not financed; testosterone supply shortages reported.
care_services.protection: Partial state coverage for surgery since 2012.
care_services.interaction: Mainly resident-facing; a visitor faces supply risk for medication.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Analysis of 70 politicians' hate-speech instances; official tolerance of smear campaigns during protests; police raid allegations.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Hate-crime provision on sexual orientation and gender identity (2012), first conviction 2018.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State actors are reported as sources of hostile framing, which weakens recourse.

minors_guardians.exposure: Attitudes toward LGBT parenting are hostile; 48% of parents would seek medical treatment for an LGBT child (2018 data).
minors_guardians.interaction: No documented traveller-facing rule on minors; attitudes are the only signal.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Pride violence in the capital (2001, 2010); pride cancellations; attacks on the LGBT centre; government reports list violence against LGBTI people.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Pride proceeded in 2022 under heavy police protection; 2014 onward capital pride held annually.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police protection was inconsistent and state response to attacks has been weak.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Hate-crime enforcement weak; 2024 police investigation has no reported outcome; 2024 register contents undetailed.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Anti-discrimination and hate-crime statutes exist; investigation opened in 2024.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Paper protections do not reliably produce sanctions.

anchor_checks.comparison: The 0.25-C case has birth-sex prison housing, a cross-dressing arrest statute and documented assaults. This dossier has no cross-dressing statute and no documented birth-sex housing (only a search recommendation), so it sits higher.
The 0.45-D case has universal registration and database exposure for all visitors. This dossier documents no visitor registration, so it sits modestly higher on universal exposure.

The 0.55-E case has uneven, sporadic harassment and ejection with weak remedies. This dossier has similar weak remedies and documented impunity, plus a police-raid allegation, so it sits similar to slightly lower.

The 0.65-D case has a working police review, sanctions and an independent oversight record. This dossier lacks sanctions for police and attacks on civil-society infrastructure, so it sits clearly lower.

parsed.synthesis: Documented exposures include a custodial search practice that places trans detainees against their identity, unsanctioned police violence allegations, repeated unsanctioned attacks on LGBT infrastructure, and hostile political framing. The main mitigation is a 2009 anti-discrimination law covering transgender status plus a 2012 hate-crime provision with weak enforcement. Paper protections do not operate reliably, so the impunity record reduces the score. No criminalisation and no documented visitor-facing border or facility rules keep the rating out of the high-risk band. Visitor-specific risk is mainly street violence and custody exposure if detained. Visitor-facing border and minor-related facts are not documented, so they are treated as open questions rather than as either safety or harm.
